run_pipeline_easyanimate: run the EasyAnimatePipeline to generate video from a text prompt with specified dimensions and inference steps
encode_prompt_easyanimate: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using the Qwen2VL or Bert text encoder with classifier-free guidance
prepare_latents_easyanimate: prepare random latent tensors with correct shape for video generation based on VAE compression ratios
retrieve_timesteps_scheduler: retrieve scheduler timesteps from a diffusion scheduler using num_inference_steps, custom timesteps, or sigmas
rescale_noise_cfg_guidance: rescale noise predictions to fix overexposure and improve image quality using guidance rescale factor
